item.title: Living room furniture has been left on the side of the path, 20th August
item.description:
Someone has dumped furniture, including a brown leather sofa and another sofa that appears to have been piled up, leaving it on the roadside. I do not know who has left these items, but they should not be there and are obstructing and spoiling the area. The dumped furniture could attract vermin and other pests if it is left there, as well as becoming a potential health and environmental nuisance. I would be grateful if the council could arrange for the furniture to be inspected and removed as soon as possible, and investigate whether the person responsible can be identified.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Hollywood Way, Slade Green, Greater London
